scope: Initial evidence register for public civic, statistical, legislative, service, finance, procurement, and sector sources identified during this research. It is not a claim that every public source or every source record has been downloaded.

sources.name: Cavinti ordinances catalog and public JSON endpoint
sources.coverage: 406 rows captured from the public endpoint; 401 distinct displayed document-number strings and 399 distinct PDF URLs; no rows missing titles, displayed dates, or PDF links. Displayed dates range from 1992-07-24 to 2026-09-28. The attached documents have not been parsed or validated.

sources.name: Cavinti resolutions catalog and public JSON endpoint
sources.coverage: 4,492 rows captured from the public endpoint; 4,436 distinct displayed document-number strings and 4,456 distinct PDF URLs; no rows missing titles, displayed dates, or PDF links. Displayed dates range from 1992-07-17 to 2026-10-12. The endpoint exposes no stable source record ID; do not deduplicate by title or number. The attached documents have not been parsed or validated.

knownGaps: The PSA current PSGC API required an access token, the public PSGC page returned 403, and OpenSTAT presented a Cloudflare challenge; the canonical current barangay list and direct 2024/2020 table exports remain unverified.

Cavinti's About page lists 17 barangay headings; Municipal Ordinance No. 051-2026 states 19; PhilAtlas separately lists 19. The names/roster must remain disputed until a primary PSGC or equivalent authoritative table is obtained.
The current Citizens' Charter page has an empty rendered service table; it does not expose the actual service catalogue, steps, fees, or requirements.

Complete metadata exports of the public ordinance and resolution endpoints were captured on 2026-10-21; the attached PDFs have not been parsed or validated, and other-document catalogs still need a complete audit.
DILG FDP, BLGF, and COA direct access failed; no finance/procurement/project totals are asserted from search misses.
The 2024 CBMS transfer page indicates that data exists, but no publishable aggregate tables or permission for household-level data were retrieved.
Social posts, school lists, health service details, infrastructure completion, tourism arrivals, and boundary geometry need source-by-source validation and freshness checks.
